assessment.headline: Day 27. IRGC Navy chief killed. Iran rejects US plan. Brent $95. But March 28 = 2 days away.
assessment.body:
The killing of IRGC Navy chief Tangsiri — the architect of the Hormuz blockade — is a massive escalation even as talks are floated. Iran is fortifying Kharg Island (90% of oil exports) fearing a US seizure operation. Tehran rejected the US 15-point plan as 'maximalist' and issued 5 counter-demands. The White House warned Trump will 'unleash hell' if no deal.

Brent crashed to $95 as Japan released 45 days of reserves — the largest ever. US gas dropped for the first time since the war began. Markets are rallying globally. But there are insider trading concerns: oil futures spiked minutes BEFORE Trump's Truth Social post.

For India: Oil dropping helps but the fundamental threat remains. 2,000 ships stranded. Iran will charge a toll for Hormuz passage even after the war. FII outflow ₹88,180 Cr in March. 59% Americans say war was wrong. UN Guterres called it 'out of control.' GCC says Iran 'crossed all red lines.' North Korea is using the war to justify its nuclear program.

March 28 is 2 days away. The 5-day pause expires. Iran's counter-demands and the US plan are miles apart. If talks fail: power plant strikes begin, Iran mines the entire Gulf, Hormuz closes completely. If they succeed: India gets the biggest oil price relief in a generation.
